meta.name: Two-voice beeper tune player (Zynaps title tune, music by Steve Turner)
meta.summary: Plays a tune of patterns with interrupts off: an order table of pattern pointers, a pattern byte $C0+n sets the note length, $FF ends the pattern, any other byte is a note number into a period table; each note runs two counters of period p and p+1 passes that flip the speaker (OUT $FE bit 4), so the two voices beat. Fire (the game's check) or the keys 1-5 end it.

entries.label: TitleTune
entries.out: carry or NZ: ended by a key
entries.summary: play the tune until a key

meta.name: picy screen unpacker (Hewson loading screens)
meta.summary: Unpacks a 6912-byte screen to $4000 from three streams (literals, masks, flags) whose offsets from the entry are in a header after the JR; a flag bit per 8 bytes says a mask byte follows, a mask bit per byte says repeat the previous byte or take a literal. Position independent: a POP HL; JP (HL) probe at $4000 finds its own address. The header's offsets and border byte differ per picture.

entries.label: PicyEntry
entries.out: the screen at $4000, the border set
entries.summary: unpack the screen

meta.name: Hewson Countdown II tape loader (decrypted)
meta.summary: The Hewson loader as it runs after its XOR chain (b[i] ^= b[i+1] over the body) is undone: a copy of the ROM's LD-BYTES whose edge loop draws a rolling four-digit countdown of the bytes still to come, then the load of the picy screen and the code file and an 18-byte stub that moves the game up and jumps to it.

entries.label: Decrypt
entries.summary: undo the XOR chain, then Start

entries.label: Start
entries.summary: load picy and the code file, move the game, jump to it

entries.label: LdBytes
entries.in: IX, DE, A, carry as the ROM's LD-BYTES
entries.summary: the ROM's LD-BYTES with the countdown

entries.label: LoadFile
entries.summary: a header, then its data at the header's address

meta.name: Kempston mouse driver of Zynaps 2 in 1 (the ship follows the mouse)
meta.summary: Reads the Kempston mouse's counters ($FBDF X, $FFDF Y) and buttons ($FADF), moves a clamped position by the counters' steps and writes it into the game's ship record: MouseReset at a life's start, MouseRead in place of the stick read.

entries.label: MouseReset
entries.summary: the position reset, the counters taken

entries.label: MouseRead
entries.out: A = the stick value: $08, $18 with a button down
entries.summary: the mouse to the ship

meta.name: Hrust 1 depacker, in place (HR header), one sector at $5B00
meta.summary: Unpacks the HR block at HL to DE in place: moves it up to end on the destination's end, unpacks forward, writes the header's six last bytes at the end, returns to the caller's caller.

entries.label: Depack
entries.in: HL = the HR block, DE = the destination
entries.summary: unpack in place

meta.name: Trush depacker (COMPRESSOR BY ALEXANDER TRUSH ODESSA), the copy a self-unpacking block puts over its head
meta.summary: Unpacks a Trush stream read through SP (bytes and 16-bit bit words interleaved) upwards from the block's base + $CE, then moves the output down to end at the block's destination end (LD SP,IX, LDDR) and returns with interrupts enabled. Relative jumps only: the same bytes in every block but the output length (LD BC at Done).

entries.label: Depack
entries.in: SP = the stream, IX = the caller's SP, B' = 16
entries.summary: unpack the stream, move the output to its end, return

meta.name: General Sound driver of Zynaps GS (ZX-Masters), bank 1 $C000: the sounds of the patched sites, the level change, the card commands
meta.summary: Called from the game's stubs with bank 1 paged: sends an effect (#2E select, #40 note, #80+c play), each command after the card took the one before (IN $BB bits 0 and 7); LevelChange swaps the level loader in at $61A8, loads the level's module and effects to the card and swaps back; RoundWait waits or fades the module between rounds.

entries.label: LevelInList
entries.summary: the first routine of the driver

entries.label: LevelChange
entries.summary: load the level's sound to the card when the level changed

meta.name: Zynaps GS patch installer: 31 sites of Zynaps hooked to the GS driver
meta.summary: Run once after the options menu at $61A8 in Trush block 4: writes the hooks into Zynaps (28 operand patches, 10 of them with a CALL opcode, 3 NOP sites), copies the driver file to bank 1, the stubs and trampolines to their places, and moves the Mover to $5BCC, which puts Zynaps's $5C00-$73FF in place and jumps to $B200.

entries.label: Install
entries.summary: install the hooks and start the game

meta.name: Softlock stub: the screen sum and the self-decrypt
meta.summary: The clear head of the code a Softlock BASIC enters through VARS: it sums the screen $4000-$5BFF as 3584 big-endian words and decrypts its own tail from +$3D with that key (XOR with the key byte, plus the previous decrypted byte, the key counting up), stopping on the first pair whose second byte is $48. The tail then copies LD-BYTES from the ROM and patches it into the turbo loader.

entries.label: Stub
entries.summary: sum the screen, decrypt the tail, fall into it

meta.notes: The BASIC of the tape carries "SOFTLOCKtm 1984"; Elite (Firebird 1985) is the only Softlock tape reversed here, so the key constants (the screen key, IY = $2E6D, the range) are this tape's.

additions.program: Elite: the Softlock decryptor (the last chunk)

meta.name: Softlock in-place decryptor keyed on the screen and the ROM
meta.summary: Loaded by the last chunk over the chunk reader at $5B00: decrypts $6049-$D0A8 top down in place, each byte minus the key byte from $5AFF downwards (the loading screen, then the ROM), XOR IYL, RLCA, XOR IYH; sets R to $FF; then fills its own page with RET by an LDIR that overwrites itself and returns into the kickoff.

entries.label: Decrypt
entries.summary: decrypt the game, wipe the page, RET to the kickoff

meta.notes: The BASIC of the tape carries "SOFTLOCKtm 1984"; Elite (Firebird 1985) is the only Softlock tape reversed here, so the key constants (the screen key, IY = $2E6D, the range) are this tape's.
